rationale: No supported optimization applies. P-LIT-GHA-CACHE is already satisfied: actions/setup-node caches npm dependencies with cache-dependency-path: docs/package-lock.json, matching the pattern contraindication 'An equivalent cache already exists'. P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE is contraindicated because this is a deployment workflow (actions/deploy-pages to the github-pages environment). P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT and P-LIT-HISTORY-TIMEOUT lack representative successful-duration history (all recorded CI runs are failures). P-LIT-FAIL-SCHEDULE and P-LIT-IDLE-SCHEDULE require schedule triggers, which this workflow_dispatch-only workflow does not have. P-LIT-FAIL-FAST requires a matrix, which is absent. Test/build selection patterns (P-LIT-SELECT, P-LIT-PRIORITIZE, P-LIT-BUILD-SELECT, P-LIT-BAZEL-*) are not applicable because the workflow builds and deploys documentation rather than running tests or Bazel builds.
